tagline: A state-driven REST API where a coffee machine behaves like a burned-out human

details.overview: An unconventional REST API that simulates a coffee machine with emotions, burnout, and evolving behavior. Each request mutates internal state, causing responses to change over time. Inspired by HTCPCP, the API blends standard HTTP practices with personality-driven logic, making it feel less like a service and more like a system that reacts.
key_features: State-driven engine with mood, caffeine, burnout, and cleanliness
Dynamic responses that change based on usage patterns
Therapy endpoint for emotional interaction with the system
Preview route to simulate full API behavior in one request
Custom headers reflecting internal system state
what_i_learned: Designing stateful systems instead of static APIs
Modeling behavior and unpredictability in backend logic
Balancing humor with real engineering structure
Using HTTP semantics creatively (status codes, headers)
Building APIs that focus on experience, not just data
